_meta.description: Regression corpus for the Annex matcher rebuild (see /root/.claude/plans/jolly-greeting-karp.md). Captured from a live manual triage session on 2026-07-19 covering every needs_review record at that time (219 entries), plus a handful of confirmed false positives from the imported set as explicit traps.
_meta.coverage_caveat: Only 1 of 219 entries is a comic/manga filename -- the comic/manga recognizer path is essentially untested by this corpus. Treat that as a known gap, not full coverage, when validating Phase 1.

resolution_categories.auto_approved_top_candidate: Live matcher's own top-scored candidate was verified correct by hand and approved as-is.
resolution_categories.manual_override: Live matcher's top candidate was wrong or missing; correct answer determined by hand (filename + general book knowledge) and submitted directly.
resolution_categories.skipped_ambiguous: No confident correct answer could be determined (degraded/generic filename, or genuinely ambiguous). expected is null -- these should NOT produce a high-confidence auto-match.
resolution_categories.known_false_positive_trap: This record was auto-imported by the live matcher onto the WRONG book/edition. See the note field for what it wrongly matched.
